summary.decision: Sugar Percussion missing-thickness-and-edge records remain blocked pending official/catalog physical shell data source review.

decisions.reason: Packet identifies candidates, but no reviewed official/catalog shell-thickness and bearing-edge evidence has been attached yet. Keep blocked until both physical fields are source-backed or separately reviewed.
requiredBeforePromotion: Official Sugar Percussion page, catalog, archived catalog, manual, or distributor spec confirming numeric shell thickness and/or bearing edge geometry.
Thickness evidence must describe actual shell thickness, not only shell construction, shell material, ply count, line name, hoop type, or era.
Bearing-edge evidence must describe edge shape/profile/detail, not only shell material, shell construction, shell thickness, hoop type, or era.
Line-level promotion requires evidence that clearly applies across the candidate records/era.

lockedRules: No Sugar Percussion shell-thickness promotion is approved from this decisions file.
No Sugar Percussion bearing-edge promotion is approved from this decisions file.
Do not treat shell construction, shell material, ply count, line name, hoop type, or era as shell-thickness or bearing-edge confirmation.
Do not promote missing/invalid physical shell fields without reviewed source evidence.
